QuestInfo.name: Did it work? Are your powers back?
QuestInfo.1: What kind of training could #p2151009# be talking about? You have been asked to come to the open lot near the fountain at #m310020100#. Better get moving.
QuestInfo.2: Fighting against someone from another dimension? Sure, why not?
QuestInfo.0: Now that you have reached Lv. 60, you hear #p2151009#'s voice in your mind. It sounds like Mastema has some thoughts on your training methods.

0.1: Oh, did I startle you? Hee hee... I mean, sorry. I wanted to make sure you could hear me, #h0#. Otherwise, this whole contract thing would be really boring for me. Hey, did you get some of your power back?
0.2: You should take your training more seriously, #h0#. I know you used to be a big-shot commander, but all that power is gone until you find a way to build it back up. Besides, the Black Mage's minions are probably looking for you, #h0#. I've thought of a way to help you, so meet me at the lot at #m310020100#.
0.3: I'll teleport you right to #b#m310020100# if you accept#k. Do you remember the Vacant Lot in #m310020100#?

no.0: Ha! You think you can refuse me, huh? Well, I'm in your head now! I can just keep talking until you do what I say. I'll just talk and talk and talk...

1.0: So, you remember this place! Good to see your memory's improving.

yes.0: We need privacy for this training, so I chose this place. Let me know when you're ready to start.

npc.0: Did you really forget? Wow, maybe we should work on your brains, first. Joking, joking! Don't look at me like that. Just come to the empty lot at #b#m310020100##k.
